note: A cue word on the same line as a time, a phone number, a booking reference and a room number, none of which is a code.
subject: Thursday
body: Can we talk at 1430 on Thursday? Use my desk line +44 20 7946 0958, or the code word is 'banana' if security asks at reception. The booking reference is BK48213 and you're in meeting room 2101.
